facts.summary: Terminated Phase 3 showed only modest exploratory benefit; new Phase 3 needed · Phase 3 · ARD-101 in Prader-Willi syndrome · not yet approved

evidence.summary: HERO trial terminated early (67 of 90 planned participants randomized); all efficacy data are considered exploratory
evidence.safety: One cardiac serious adverse event was observed in the HERO trial at 800 mg twice daily (BID) in a participant who was also taking pitolisant, a CYP2D6 substrate.
